start.title: [TODO:ar] One Language
start.text:
[TODO:ar] The whole earth has one language and a common speech.
Where do the people settle?

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Settle in the plain of Shinar
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Genesis 11:2 — As people moved eastward, they found a plain in Shinar and settled there.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Sail east across a great sea
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Genesis says the people settled in the plain of Shinar.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Scatter across the earth right away
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] The people did not scatter yet — that came later, as judgment.

unity.title: [TODO:ar] One Speech
unity.text:
[TODO:ar] You look at your neighbors.
How do you all speak?

choices.text: [TODO:ar] You all speak the same language, one common speech
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Genesis 11:1 — The whole world had one language and a common speech.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Every family speaks a different tongue
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Genesis says everyone spoke one language at this point.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] No one speaks at all
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Genesis says the people spoke — with one common speech.

proposal.title: [TODO:ar] The Proposal
proposal.text:
[TODO:ar] The people gather.
What do they propose to build?

choices.text: [TODO:ar] 'Let us build a city, and a tower that reaches to the heavens — and make a name for ourselves'
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Genesis 11:4 — They said, 'Come, let us build ourselves a city, with a tower that reaches to the heavens, so that we may make a name for ourselves.'

choices.text: [TODO:ar] 'Let us build an altar to the Lord'
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Genesis says they built a city and a tower to make a name for themselves, not an altar.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] 'Let us go back and travel alone'
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Genesis says the people stayed together to build.

bricks.title: [TODO:ar] Bricks and Tar
bricks.text:
[TODO:ar] You gather materials for the great work.
How do you build?

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Make bricks and bake them thoroughly, using tar for mortar
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Genesis 11:3 — They said, 'Come, let's make bricks and bake them thoroughly.' They used brick instead of stone, and tar for mortar.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Cut stones from the mountains
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Genesis says they used bricks and tar, not cut stones.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Weave the tower from reeds
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Genesis says they used baked bricks and tar.

construction.title: [TODO:ar] The City and the Tower
construction.text:
[TODO:ar] The work begins.
What do you build together?

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Build a city and a tower with its top in the heavens
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Genesis 11:4-5 — They set out to build a city and a tower with its top in the heavens.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Build separate homes far from one another
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Genesis says they built one city together, not scattered homes.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Build a bridge across the sea
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Genesis says they built a city and a tower, not a bridge.

rising.title: [TODO:ar] Higher and Higher
rising.text:
[TODO:ar] The tower climbs into the sky.
Why do the people keep building?

choices.text: [TODO:ar] To make a name for themselves, so they will not be scattered over the earth
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Genesis 11:4 — 'Let us make a name for ourselves, and not be scattered over the face of the whole earth.'

choices.text: [TODO:ar] To honor the Lord who made the heavens
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Genesis says they built to make a name for themselves, not to honor the Lord.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] To hide from a coming flood
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] God had already promised never again to flood the earth (Genesis 9).

summit.title: [TODO:ar] The Lord Comes Down
summit.text: [TODO:ar] The tower rises. What happens next?

choices.text: [TODO:ar] The Lord comes down to see the city and the tower
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Genesis 11:5 — The Lord came down to see the city and the tower the people were building.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] The tower reaches heaven and the people enter it
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Genesis does not say the tower reached heaven; the Lord came down to see it.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Angels descend to help the workers build
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Genesis does not describe angels helping to build.

gods_gaze.title: [TODO:ar] The Lord's Decision
gods_gaze.text:
[TODO:ar] The Lord speaks about the people.
What does He decide to do?

choices.text: [TODO:ar] 'Come, let us go down and confuse their language'
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Genesis 11:6-7 — The Lord said, 'Come, let us go down and confuse their language so they will not understand each other.'

choices.text: [TODO:ar] 'Let us praise their great work'
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Genesis says the Lord confused their language, not praised the tower.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] 'Let us destroy the tower with fire'
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Genesis says the Lord confused their language and scattered them, not that He destroyed the tower with fire.

confusion.title: [TODO:ar] Strange Words
confusion.text:
[TODO:ar] You turn to your neighbor and speak.
What happens?

choices.text: [TODO:ar] You can no longer understand one another's speech
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Genesis 11:7 — The Lord confused their language so they could not understand each other.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Everyone suddenly speaks even more clearly
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Genesis says their speech was confused, not made clearer.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Everyone falls silent and never speaks again
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Genesis says the languages were confused, not that speech ended.

scattering.title: [TODO:ar] Scattered Over the Earth
scattering.text:
[TODO:ar] The building stops.
What happens to the people?

choices.text: [TODO:ar] The Lord scatters them from there over all the earth, and they stop building the city
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Genesis 11:8 — The Lord scattered them from there over all the earth, and they stopped building the city.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] The people stay in Shinar and finish the tower
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Genesis says they stopped building and were scattered.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] The people sail back to Eden
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Genesis says they were scattered over the whole earth, not that they returned to Eden.

reflection.title: [TODO:ar] Babel
reflection.text:
[TODO:ar] That is why the city was called Babel —
for there the Lord confused the language of the whole world.
